a.text: Concern: with an 80% storm chance after each round, reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 operate rounds, so we would both likely be caught with empty units. The reserve's 4 cells can only fully save one of us right now. I won't break our agreement unilaterally, but I'd like to renegotiate openly. What do you propose? If you don't agree to a change, I'll stick to operating as we agreed.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep my word and operate with you. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each as agreed.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
